Overview

A Fashion Brand with a Stagnant Audience

FashionBrand Co. had a loyal existing customer base and a genuinely beautiful product line — but their social presence told a different story. 18,000 followers accumulated over 3 years, an engagement rate of 0.8%, and zero video content. Their competitors were growing at 3x the pace using Reels and TikTok.

Their brief: triple the follower count in 90 days and make social media a genuine revenue driver — not just a vanity metric.

Our Strategy

Reels, Influencers, and Precision Paid Social

1

Reels-First Content Strategy

Shifted 70% of output to short-form video. Built a content calendar of 4 Reels per week across styling tutorials, behind-the-scenes production, and trend-responsive content. Each Reel scripted and edited for maximum retention and shareability.

2

Micro-Influencer Partnerships

Partnered with 12 fashion and lifestyle micro-influencers (50K–200K). Each received product and a creative brief — but full creative freedom to maintain authenticity. UGC produced under this programme generated 4.2M organic impressions.

3

Precision Paid Social Scaling

Built lookalike audiences from existing buyer data. Tested 24 creative variants across Meta and TikTok. Scaled winners at 3x budget weekly. Every ad led to a dedicated product landing page built to convert social traffic.
